task: predict epitope among exposed antigen residues (RSA>=0.25); cluster30-grouped 5-fold CV
features_full: aa one-hot (20) + ss3 one-hot (3) + relative accessibility (1)
note_imbalanced: task is imbalanced (~17% positive), so PR-AUC/average precision and precision-recall are the informative metrics; ROC-AUC is reported for comparability
interpretation: All models sit just above the no-skill baseline (PR-AUC ~= the 0.17 base rate; ROC-AUC ~0.56), and composition+secondary structure add little over accessibility, confirming that an exposed epitope is barely distinguishable from equally exposed surface.
